decisions.note: Require takeover-specific knowledge and a mark scheme that accepts valid takeover-specific explanation routes; deepen the Foundation first so the question is supported by approved teaching.

Remove the answer-giving synergy wording from the scenario and require the learner to identify and explain the synergy mechanism; deepen the Foundation first with an explicit synergy definition and mechanisms.
Add crisis-management teaching to BUS-STR-009, then regenerate and review the dependent question rather than removing the examinable item.
Deepen the mapped BUS-FND-001 teaching with the mission/objective relationship and the purposes of objectives, then regenerate the question against that teaching.

Regenerate so the question genuinely assesses social-enterprise knowledge and limited versus unlimited liability, with marking points aligned to the Explain task and valid alternative reasons credited.
Regenerate the mark scheme so an open Explain question about ordinary share capital and why shareholders invest credits valid shareholder-return routes such as dividends and capital gain.
Deepen the mapped BUS-FND-009 teaching with environmental issues and business transmission mechanisms, then regenerate the dependent question.
Regenerate without giving away the regulator's role in the scenario; require the learner to use regulator knowledge to explain the business effect.
Deepen the mapped BUS-OPS-001 teaching with environmental objectives and operational examples, then regenerate the dependent question.
Regenerate so the learner must use knowledge of emerging economies as well as globalisation, and align all marking points to the requested explanation rather than generic export effects.
Regenerate without describing licensing so explicitly that the scenario gives the answer away; the learner must identify and explain the relevant route using taught knowledge.
Regenerate so multinational knowledge is genuinely assessed and the mark scheme rewards explanation rather than repetition of facts supplied in the question.
Add explicit Lewin force field analysis teaching to BUS-STR-009, including driving and restraining forces and the model's limits, then regenerate and review the dependent question.
